The judge should exclude the evidence of the man’s prior similar acts if offered only to show propensity or likelihood that he molested this child, as that is impermissible character evidence. It may be admissible only if it is relevant to a proper purpose such as motive, intent, plan, identity, or absence of mistake, and if its probative value is not substantially outweighed by unfair prejudice.  
CONFIDENCE: 95
